description: This Kotlin source file provides utility functions for handling back key presses within a smart TV or set-top box (STB) context. It manages clearing search input fields when the back key is pressed, and ensures consistent back key behavior across the app's UI components.

classes.name: TvBackKeySearchClear
classes.description: A singleton object that encapsulates utilities for handling back key events to clear search inputs and maintain consistent back navigation behaviors in TV/STB applications.

methods.name: registerBackToClearSearch
methods.description: Registers an OnBackPressedCallback that clears the focused EditText if it has text, and keeps focus on it. Allows back navigation to proceed if conditions aren't met.

methods.name: consumeBackKeyToClearIfNeeded
methods.description: A fallback method to clear the EditText and consume the back key event if the EditText is focused and has text.

methods.name: installKeyListener
methods.description: Attaches a key listener to the EditText to handle the back key event at the view level, consuming the event when appropriate.
